user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Penny Arcade Pier. A Victorian seaside pier arcade at dusk: a mechanical fortune-teller booth with a glowing turbaned automaton, a strength-test hammer machine with a bell tower, a carousel horse on a brass pole, cast-iron lamp posts strung with round bulbs, wooden boardwalk planks, a telescope on the rail, distant sea and gulls, and bulbs chasing in sequence along the arcade fascia. Style: seaside victorian whimsy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
